notes.title: I want to be the game dev update
notes.notes:
Hey after a while I started working on a lot of features that seemed missing, the game was too hard or easy in some areas, controls felt a bit clunky content was limited by it's levels so I hope this addresses some of these problems.

List of Content:
20 NEW LEVELS, i mean 20 new levels.
New surface, slider, touch this and you'll go SWOOSH alright.

POWER UPS
Second jump
Jump mid air, slow down time, or be a nihilist and just watch as you get sent back to the start even faster/slower than before.

Shields
You have a way to protect yourself from those pesky projectiles for a few seconds before they start blastin' again.

Enemies
Yea I thought the game wasn't miserable enough so I added in some things that shoot you and are overall annoying.

Killer enemies, send you back, not in time Jack, to the checkpoint.
Knockback enemies it would be a shame if you missed because of someone,
Slowdown enemies, yea no fun zone here.
*There are also homing variants of these.

Level Editor:
No you can't change the levels I made I'm sorry.
But you can make your own and share them in case you wanted an easier time or a downright miserable one.

You get to do all the things I get to do but you get to show me how much better you are at this than me. 

Achievements
Yes, now, I, get to mock whoever dares own this copy of the game in another way.


Boring stuff here,
Changes,
Tutorials got extra pazzaz, made some easier and added some text.
Gravity inverters now play a SFX when you hit them and a little visual feedback.
Options now have a difficulty setting which controls the trajectory distance.
Changed the text on main menu to V2.0.0 :D.
BUGS fixed of various assortments and what not.

Anyway if you have problems or bugs or want to send me a good job sticker please send to 
->swooshhelpdeskep@gmail.com

P.S.
Mac
